premise: Four spacecraft want the one landing pad at once — the supply pod, the lander, the booster and the huge ship — and politely take turns, each landing and moving aside for the next.
inspiration: The Ukrainian folk tale 'The Mitten', where animal after animal squeezes into one mitten until it bursts, turned: nobody squeezes — they take turns.

en-US.title: One Pad, Four Landings
en-US.text: [excited] It was the busiest day the landing pad had ever seen. Four spacecraft were coming in, and there was only one pad! {all:face surprised} First came the {supply-pod:enter} {supply-pod:go to pad} supply pod, small and quick. {sfx:thud} Thump! {supply-pod:live} It opened up to unload its crates, then {supply-pod:go to plain} hopped aside to make room. Next came the {lander:enter} {lander:go to pad} lander, on its four round feet. {canvas:dust 0.5 6s} {lander:live} It opened its hatch for a moment, then {lander:go to plain} shuffled aside too. Then the tall {booster:enter} {booster:go to pad} booster came down, tail first. {booster:wobble} {booster:live} It checked its legs, and then {booster:go to plain} stepped politely out of the way. [short pause] And last of all, the huge {ship:enter} {ship:go to pad} ship came down, slow and gentle, onto the empty pad. [playfully] Nobody bumped. Nobody squeezed. {ship:pulse} Everybody took turns. {all:face happy} {all:hop} [happily] And for one day, the Moon had the tidiest landing pad in space.

es-ES.title: Una plataforma, cuatro aterrizajes
es-ES.text: [excited] Era el día de más trabajo de la plataforma de aterrizaje. Llegaban cuatro naves, ¡y solo había una plataforma! {all:face surprised} Primero llegó la {supply-pod:enter} {supply-pod:go to pad} cápsula de carga, pequeña y rápida. {sfx:thud} ¡Pum! {supply-pod:live} Se abrió para descargar sus cajas, y luego {supply-pod:go to plain} se apartó de un saltito para dejar sitio. Luego llegó el {lander:enter} {lander:go to pad} módulo lunar, sobre sus cuatro patas redondas. {canvas:dust 0.5 6s} {lander:live} Abrió la escotilla un momento, y después {lander:go to plain} se apartó también. Después bajó el alto {booster:enter} {booster:go to pad} cohete propulsor, de cola. {booster:wobble} {booster:live} Probó sus patas, y luego {booster:go to plain} se hizo a un lado, muy educado. [short pause] Y por último, la enorme {ship:enter} {ship:go to pad} nave bajó, despacio y suave, hasta la plataforma vacía. [playfully] Nadie chocó. Nadie se apretujó. {ship:pulse} Todos esperaron su turno. {all:face happy} {all:hop} [happily] Y durante un día, la Luna tuvo la plataforma más ordenada del espacio.

thud.prompt: a soft, deep, muffled thud felt through the ground, as if heard through thick boots
